name: Komori Taku
source:
A second-year transfer student from Kirameki High. He is introverted and anti-social. For some reasons, he dislikes going to school and tends to ditch a lot. He'll open up if the player consistently visits him.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side:_2nd_Kiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
